source.basis: Historical official image-generation references and local Fish tests
source.confidence: Historical prompt observations; not a current model-capability guarantee

verification_log.note: This table is prompt knowledge, not a validated status. Re-evaluate when models change or observations become stale.
verification_log.trigger: Model change, pricing change or 90 days without evaluation

dynamic_facts_policy: Discover current prices, parameters and resolutions using get_media_model and estimate tools; do not store them here.

prompt_dialect.structure_formula: Scene/backdrop → subject → key details → constraints → output intent
prompt_dialect.labeled_lines: Use case / Scene / Subject / Style / Composition / Lighting / Materials / Text(verbatim) / Constraints / Avoid
prompt_dialect.photoreal_rule: Concrete photographic framing, light and real material texture; avoid excessive polish
prompt_dialect.product_mockup_recipe: Clean outline, neutral studio gradient, softbox, controlled shadows, centered or three-quarter framing, whitespace and subtle reflection
prompt_dialect.specificity_policy: Structure a specific brief without adding unsupported objects, people or brands; resolve generic photographic detail when needed
prompt_dialect.negative_handling: Use Constraints for requirements and Avoid for unwanted elements
prompt_dialect.identity_handling: Use reference-image edit; say exactly the same product as in the reference; verify actual identity rather than assuming a guarantee
prompt_dialect.iteration_rule: Start from a clean base, change one target, restate invariants
prompt_dialect.text_rendering: Exact quoted text and typography only when explicitly requested

constraints_render._note: Translate selected shared/category rules without redefining them
constraints_render.no_text: Constraints: no text anywhere in the image / Avoid: text, lettering, logos, watermarks
constraints_render.only_container: Constraints: the product is the only cup/bottle/vessel in frame / Avoid: additional containers
constraints_render.no_steam: Avoid: steam or vapor around the product
constraints_render.lid_state: Constraints: lid shown closed / open exactly as in the reference

lighting_vocabulary.studio: softbox lighting, clean highlights, controlled shadows, studio gradient backdrop
lighting_vocabulary.morning: soft window light, gentle shadows, natural color balance
lighting_vocabulary.avoid: Vague dramatic-lighting instructions without a concrete source

pitfalls: Unrequested props can be added unless constraints are explicit
Product identity needs reference-guided editing and output inspection
Hyper-realistic/8K/masterpiece wording can encourage overpolished imagery
